# Hard cases, picked by hand: halfway cases, the largest and smallest normal
# and subnormal doubles, 800 digits and more, exponents past ±400, and
# texts that are not JSON numbers. Each case is a comment line saying what
# it is, then "<text> <bits>" (or "invalid"). See README.md.
# halfway: 2^53 + 1 rounds to even, down
9007199254740993 4340000000000000
# halfway: 2^53 + 3 rounds to even, up
9007199254740995 4340000000000002
# halfway between 1 and the next double: to even, 1
1.00000000000000011102230246251565404236316680908203125 3ff0000000000000
# the same, a digit above it far down: up
1. 3ff0000000000001
# the same, a digit below it: 1 + 2^-53 - 10^-60
1.000000000000000111022302462515654042363166809082031249999999 3ff0000000000000
# the largest normal
1.7976931348623157e308 7fefffffffffffff
# the largest normal, every digit
 7fefffffffffffff
# halfway between the largest and 2^1024: out of range
 invalid
# just below that halfway: the largest
 7fefffffffffffff
# the smallest normal
2.2250738585072014e-308 0010000000000000
# the largest subnormal
2.225073858507201e-308 000fffffffffffff
# the smallest subnormal
5e-324 0000000000000001
# the smallest subnormal, more digits
4.9406564584124654e-324 0000000000000001
# halfway between 0 and the smallest subnormal: to even, 0
0. 0000000000000000
# the same, negative: -0
-0. 8000000000000000
# a digit above that halfway: the smallest subnormal
0. 0000000000000001
# 2.4703282292062327e-324: below the halfway, 0
2.4703282292062327e-324 0000000000000000
# 2.4703282292062328e-324: above the halfway, the smallest subnormal
2.4703282292062328e-324 0000000000000001
# 1e-324 is 0
1e-324 0000000000000000
# 1e-323
1e-323 0000000000000002
# an exponent past -400: 0
1e-400 0000000000000000
# an exponent past -400, negative: -0
-1e-400 8000000000000000
# an exponent past +400: out of range
1e400 invalid
# a mantissa that brings it back: 1e-400 × 10^400
0. 3ff0000000000000
# 1000 digits of 1: out of range
 invalid
# 1000 digits after the point, the last 1
0. 0000000000000000
# 800 digits of 9 with the point after the first
9. 4024000000000000
# 1 + 10^-16 and a 1 past the 800th digit: 1, the digits past 800 a sticky flag
1. 3ff0000000000000
# 0.1
0.1 3fb999999999999a
# 0.2
0.2 3fc999999999999a
# 0.3
0.3 3fd3333333333333
# 1/3 to 40 digits
0.3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 3fd5555555555555
# 2^63 as a float text
9223372036854775808.0 43e0000000000000
# 2^64 + 1
18446744073709551617 43f0000000000000
# a 19-digit mantissa
1234567890123456789e-10 419d6f34540ca458
# a 20-digit mantissa (truncated)
12345678901234567891e-10 41d26580b487e6b7
# a capital exponent with a sign
1E+2 4059000000000000
# an exponent with leading zeros
1e007 416312d000000000
# Clinger: an integer times a power of ten
123456789e22 462f2a353f39e270
# Clinger: past it
123456789e30 47d7383a694e0c79
# Clinger: divided
123456789e-22 3d0bcccca1f70d61

+1 invalid
